technique_name: Develop a simple marketing plan using the provided information.
description: Our marketing plan aims to reach teachers and school administrators as our primary target audience. We plan to create ads and content on social media, particularly on channels like YouTube, Facebook, and LinkedIn which are frequented by our target audience. We would also like to establish relationships with educational publications so that we can publish articles and press releases that showcase the capabilities of our platform. We will also use Google and Facebook Ads to reach out to our target
example:
Product Description: An online platform for teachers to create and share video lessons
Target Audience: Teachers and School Administrators
